why: Both make the right call: keep the grant but add standard 4-year vesting with a 1-year cliff, and file an 83(b) election. Advice 2 adds things Advice 1 leaves out: a day-one IP assignment, credit for time already worked, acceleration terms, and why fixing this later is harder once he holds leverage. Advice 1 has a useful 'stop if he rejects vesting' signal, but some of its risk points are vague.
